## Question

State the question in one sentence, as a user would ask it.

## Context

What are you trying to do, and what have you already tried? Include the
contract function, configuration, or document you were reading, if any.

## Expected answer (optional)

If you know what the answer should say, describe it here.

## Existing FAQ entry (optional)

If this is about an existing answer, link to it: https://github.com/TwinTrustMainstay/Mainstay/blob/main/docs/faq.md

Do not include personal data, private keys, or API keys in this issue.
